description: This file defines the ManufacturerService interface, which declares methods for managing manufacturers within an e-commerce system. The interface extends a generic service and includes methods for listing, saving, updating, deleting manufacturers, and additional specific functions related to manufacturer descriptions and associated products.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a given merchant store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a given merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new manufacturer or updates an existing one.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products from specified categories within a store.
